moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax. The last two weekend buy calls missed, and the sell-the-spike call on Capdevila missed too (142,000 to 160,000), so do not sell a card just because it jumped.

verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 103.49 (+0.07% on the last reading) and the momentum gauge reads 41.5. 84s cost 750, 85s 2,200 and 86s 3,600 (FUT.GG cheapest by rating). It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best, but the last weekend buy calls missed and a sell-the-spike call missed too.
verdict.headline: Momentum is 41.5, so prices are falling: buy only with a clear reason.
verdict.label: Falling, be selective
